about: Rule registry. Each rule's ID, level, title and message/hint templates. Placeholders in braces are filled by the validator. IDs are never reused or renamed. 'applies' says where a rule runs: asset or composition folders, and 'runner' says which tool runs it (validate = the folder validator, check-pr = needs git and pull-request context).
signoffStatement: I made this asset, or I have the right to release every part of it, including its textures, scans and any AI tool output. I release it under CC0 1.0. It contains no real brands, logos, recognisable characters or likenesses of real people.

rules.title: The version folder holds only the expected files
rules.message: {detail}
rules.hint: An asset folder holds asset.json, model.glb and optionally collision.glb; a composition folder holds only composition.json. Remove or rename anything else.

rules.title: Each file is within the size budget
rules.message: {file} is {measured} bytes; the limit is {limit} bytes{context}.
rules.hint: Reduce the file: lower the texture resolution, use JPEG for photographic colour maps, or remove unused data, then export again.

rules.title: asset.json validates against the schema
rules.message: asset.json {detail}
rules.hint: Fix the field named in the message so asset.json matches spec/asset.schema.json. Run `propcommons validate` again to check.

rules.title: id and version match the folder path
rules.message: The manifest says {measured} but the folder path is {limit}.
rules.hint: Set id to "author/slug" and version to N so they match the folder assets/author/slug/vN (or compositions/author/slug/vN).

rules.title: parent names a version that exists and is not taken down
rules.message: parent {measured} {detail}.
rules.hint: Point parent at an existing, live version, written as author/slug@N, or remove the field.

rules.title: model.glb passes the Khronos glTF Validator
rules.message: {file} is not a valid glTF 2.0 binary: {detail}
rules.hint: Export again as a binary glTF (.glb) from a current exporter, and check it with the Khronos glTF Validator. Later checks are skipped until this passes.

rules.title: All buffers and images are embedded
rules.message: {file} refers to an external file: {detail}.
rules.hint: Export as a single .glb with all textures and buffers embedded, not as .gltf with separate files.

rules.title: No required extensions, and only allowlisted extensions used
rules.message: {file} uses extensions that are not allowed: {measured}.
rules.hint: Turn off compression (Draco, Meshopt, KTX2, WebP) and any extension other than {limit} in the exporter, then export again.

rules.title: One scene with one untransformed root node
rules.message: {detail}
rules.hint: Join everything into a single object (or parent it under one empty), apply all transforms so the root has no translation, rotation or scale, and export one scene.

rules.title: No node has a scale other than 1
rules.message: Node "{node}" has scale {measured}.
rules.hint: Apply scale (in Blender: Object > Apply > Scale) on every object so all scales are 1, then export again. A negative scale mirrors the mesh; fix its normals after applying.

rules.title: No cameras, lights, animations, skins or morph targets
rules.message: The model contains {measured}.
rules.hint: Delete cameras, lights, animations, armatures and shape keys, or turn them off in the exporter, then export again.

rules.title: The longest side falls inside the declared size class
rules.message: The longest side is {measured} m, outside the {class} range of {limit} m.
rules.hint: If the model is the right size, change size_class in asset.json. If it is about 100 times too big or small, it was exported in centimetres: rescale to metres and apply the scale.

rules.title: The lowest point is at y = 0
rules.message: The lowest point of the model is {measured} m {direction} the origin.
rules.hint: Move the mesh {fix} by {abs} m so its lowest point sits at y = 0, then apply the transform and export again.

rules.title: Seen from above, the origin lies inside the bounding box
rules.message: Seen from above, the origin is outside the model's footprint, {measured} m from its centre.
rules.hint: Move the mesh so the centre of its footprint is at x = 0, z = 0, then apply the transform and export again.

rules.title: The origin is near the footprint's centre
rules.message: The origin is {measured} m from the footprint's centre; the limit is {limit} m (25% of the footprint's width).
rules.hint: Move the mesh by ({dx}, {dz}) m in x and z so the footprint is centred on the origin, unless an off-centre origin is deliberate.

rules.title: Every primitive is a triangle list
rules.message: {measured} primitive(s) are not triangle lists: {detail}.
rules.hint: Triangulate the mesh (in Blender: a Triangulate modifier, applied) and remove loose edges and points, then export again.

rules.title: The triangle count is within budget
rules.message: The model has {measured} triangles; the budget for size class {class} is {limit}.
rules.hint: Reduce the mesh by about {percent}%, or move fine surface detail into the normal map.

rules.title: Every primitive has positions, normals, and UVs where textured
rules.message: {measured} primitive(s) are missing attributes: {detail}.
rules.hint: Export with normals turned on, and unwrap UVs for every textured part before exporting.

rules.title: No vertex colours
rules.message: {measured} primitive(s) have vertex colours.
rules.hint: Bake vertex colours into the base colour texture, then remove the colour attributes or turn off vertex colours in the exporter.

rules.title: The number of materials is within budget
rules.message: The model uses {measured} materials; the budget for size class {class} is {limit}.
rules.hint: Merge materials that share a shader into one, using a texture atlas if needed.

rules.title: Alpha mode is opaque or mask
rules.message: {measured} material(s) use alpha mode BLEND: {detail}.
rules.hint: Use OPAQUE, or MASK with a cutoff, unless the transparency must be smooth. For glass, use KHR_materials_transmission instead of blend.

rules.title: Every image is PNG or JPEG
rules.message: {measured} image(s) are not PNG or JPEG: {detail}.
rules.hint: Save the textures as PNG (or JPEG for photographic colour maps) and export again with compression turned off.

rules.title: Image sides are powers of two and within budget
rules.message: Image {detail} is {measured} px; sides must be powers of two and at most {limit} px for size class {class}.
rules.hint: Resize the texture to a power of two no larger than {limit} px on each side (for example {limit}×{limit}), then export again.

rules.title: Occlusion and metallic-roughness share one image
rules.message: {measured} material(s) use separate images for occlusion and metallic-roughness.
rules.hint: Pack occlusion (R), roughness (G) and metallic (B) into one ORM texture and use it for both slots.

rules.title: Texel density is measured
rules.message: Texel density is {measured} px/m.
rules.hint: No limit yet in 0.1; this number helps match the rest of the kit.

rules.title: collision.glb holds only meshes
rules.message: collision.glb contains {measured}.
rules.hint: Export the collision collection with materials, textures and extensions turned off. It must be a valid glTF binary with meshes only.

rules.title: At most 8 convex hulls of at most 64 vertices each
rules.message: {detail}
rules.hint: Use at most {hulls} collision meshes, each a closed convex hull of at most {vertices} vertices (in Blender: Convex Hull, then Decimate).

rules.title: Collision stays inside the model's bounding box
rules.message: The collision shapes extend {measured} m outside the model's bounding box; the allowance is {limit} m.
rules.hint: Keep collision shapes in the same coordinate frame as the model, with the same origin and no extra transform, and shrink any that stick out.

rules.title: A new version is 1 or one higher than the latest merged version
rules.message: {target} adds version {measured}, but the next version must be {limit}.
rules.hint: Rename the folder to v{limit} and set version to {limit} in the manifest.

rules.title: No change to an already-merged version folder
rules.message: The pull request changes {measured}, inside a version folder that is already merged.
rules.hint: Merged versions never change. Put your change in a new version folder, v{next}, and leave the old one as it is.

rules.title: Files are added only under the contributor's own handle
rules.message: The pull request by {author} adds {measured}, which is not under {author}'s own folder.
rules.hint: Move the work to assets/{author}/... (or compositions/{author}/...) and record the original in parent if it derives from someone else's asset.

rules.title: The pull request carries the sign-off statement
rules.message: The pull request description does not contain the sign-off statement with its box ticked.
rules.hint: Edit the pull request description: keep the sign-off statement from the template word for word and tick its box. A person must confirm it, not an agent.

rules.title: composition.json validates against its schema
rules.message: composition.json {detail}
rules.hint: Fix the field named in the message so composition.json matches spec/composition.schema.json.

rules.title: Every item pins a live asset version
rules.message: Item {index} pins {measured}, which {detail}.
rules.hint: Pin an asset version that exists in assets/ and is not taken down, written as author/slug@N.

rules.title: Every rotation is a unit quaternion
rules.message: Item {index} has a rotation of length {measured}; it must be 1 within {limit}.
rules.hint: Normalise the quaternion (divide each of x, y, z, w by its length). The order is x, y, z, w, as in glTF.

rules.title: Between 2 and 200 items
rules.message: The composition has {measured} items; it needs between {min} and {limit}.
rules.hint: A composition places at least two assets and at most 200. Split a larger scene into several compositions.

rules.title: Every scale is between 0.5 and 2
rules.message: Item {index} has scale {measured}, outside {min} to {limit}.
rules.hint: Assets are already at real-world size. If you need a much bigger or smaller version, make it a new asset instead of scaling.
